'''''Imperial''''' was the name of a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] [[Time/Legends|sometime]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was made available during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. It depicted [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Forces]], wielding [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and reaching out his left [[Limb/Legends|hand]]. [[Color/Legends|Orange]] clouds and black smoke were pictured in the background.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
This painting appeared in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, the actual name of the painting was '''''Seven Years of Galaxies: Imperial'''''. It was intended to commemorate the seven year anniversary of ''Star Wars Galaxies''. The painting was obtainable during the [[2010]] Empire Day celebrations.<ref name="SWG" />
